failures.criterion: Scope addition: the checks pill shows what GitHub's merge reads
failures.evidence: The pill counts the check runs of workflow runs whose event GitHub does not evaluate for a pull request. GitHub evaluates only push, pull_request, pull_request_review, pull_request_target, deployment and deployment_status runs (docs: troubleshooting-required-status-checks, 'Checks from some workflow jobs are not evaluated'). Live: sjawhar/legion#2234 head 44eab33b has a queued pull_request_review_comment PR Title run (40397602421, check run 121834675879). GitHub's PR rollup is SUCCESS and its contexts list only the pull_request_review pr-title. The pill's rule gives pending. #2059's head 1713cb91 has five failed review-comment pr-title runs that GitHub's contexts omit too. Red tests: cdf24efc adds the IssuePage.test.tsx case 'a failed and a waiting check of an event GitHub does not evaluate'. Running `cd packages/dispatch && bun test web/src/features/issue/IssuePage.test.tsx -t "merged pull request"` gives 5 pass, 1 fail, 'Unable to find an element with the text: checks: success'. 5a0a94c2 adds e2e/github-checks.e2e.ts 'the checks pill ignores checks of events GitHub does not evaluate for a pull request'. Running `bun run e2e e2e/github-checks.e2e.ts` gives 2 failed (chromium, iphone), 4 passed, Expected 'checks: success', Received 'checks: failure'. Fix: drop a check run whose workflow run's event is outside GitHub's evaluated list before taking the newest per key; an external App's check (no workflow run) still counts.

failures.criterion: CI green at the code head (lint, typecheck, test, pr-title)
failures.evidence: No workflow run exists for 13bd6a70 or 28e8947f: `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs?head_sha=<sha>` returns none for either. The push that carried the code commits 4dffee8f..13bd6a70 (packages/dispatch, packages/envoy) ended at 28e8947f, whose message ends 'skip-checks: true'. A code push must carry no trailer. The pull request is also mergeStateStatus DIRTY: `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/main 28e8947f` reports a conflict in packages/dispatch/e2e/fake-github.ts (main is 65 commits ahead), and GitHub runs no pull_request checks on a conflicting head. So the new Go proxy, the web code and the browser suite have no CI verdict. Fix: forward-merge main (a real conflict), then push with no trailer. The red tests above must pass after the merge.
